title: SessionContext
description: App-owned working context supplied to AI as a snapshot. Only mode and currentTask are required.

focusDurationSeconds.description: Planned total focus duration in seconds; not elapsed or remaining time. Omitted means unspecified.

allowedApps.description: Normalized app labels. Omitted means unspecified; [] means no explicit entries.

blockedApps.description: Normalized app labels. Omitted means unspecified; [] means no explicit entries.

metadata.description: Optional normalized extension fields. Do not include raw provider API objects or credentials.

currentTask.description: Human-readable task text; null means no task selected.

focusStartedAt.description: Original focus-session start time; null means no focus session. Omission means timing is not supplied.
